<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920090_theRebbe_103" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920090_theRebbe_103__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>To understand this, we must preface with what was explained elsewhere, that "Eikev" refers to the era of the heels of Moshiach, when you will surely listen, and through the service of thought, speech, and action in Torah and mitzvos, one unites with Hashem and draws down revelations from above, but this is only possible through the covenant.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And to understand this, we must first preface with what was explained elsewhere,</t>
    <t s="1">that "Eikev" refers to the time of the heels of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="2">for then "you will surely listen,"</t>
    <t s="3">because it is the last generation,</t>
    <t s="4">and no one from it will be lost,</t>
    <t s="5">therefore in this generation you will surely listen.</t>
    <t s="6">And the entirety of the service is "you will listen, and guard, and do,"</t>
    <t s="7">which is thought, speech, and action,</t>
    <t s="8">and when his thought-speech-action are from the Nefesh HaElokis alone,</t>
    <t s="9">and it is the thought-speech-action of Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="10">then "Hashem your G-d will guard for you the covenant, and the kindness, and the oath,"</t>
    <t s="11">that the thought-speech-action from above will be drawn down to him.</t>
    <t s="12">For in general, through his service, there is a unification of the worshiper with the Worshipped,</t>
    <t s="13">a unification of Neshama of Yisrael with the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="14">a unification face-to-face,</t>
    <t s="15">and through the love of "with all your might,"</t>
    <t s="16">he draws down revelations that are above the chain of descent.</t>
    <t s="17">However, this—that through his service he draws down the revelation from above—</t>
    <t s="18">is only from the aspect of the covenant alone,</t>
    <t s="19">for He is not at all from any of these attributes,</t>
    <t s="20">and in order that the action of created beings should take hold,</t>
    <t s="21">it is only from the aspect of the covenant.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The covenant is the Torah, which is the medium connecting the Neshama of Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He, having two aspects—one relating to the creations and one relating to Hashem—through which it unites them.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the concept of the covenant is the Torah,</t>
    <t s="2">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="3">"the covenant which He made with us at Chorev,"</t>
    <t s="4">and in the Yalkut,</t>
    <t s="5">on the verse,</t>
    <t s="6">"These are the words of the covenant," it is stated,</t>
    <t s="7">"There is no covenant but Torah,"</t>
    <t s="8">meaning that the Torah is the covenant that unites the Neshama of Yisrael with the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="9">and as it is written,</t>
    <t s="10">"I stand between Hashem and you,"</t>
    <t s="11">"Anochi" is "I am who I am,"</t>
    <t s="12">which is not hinted at in any letter or any crownlet,</t>
    <t s="13">in general it is the Kesser,</t>
    <t s="14">it connects Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He, through the Torah.</t>
    <t s="15">And the explanation of the concept is,</t>
    <t s="16">based on the known principle that in every medium that connects two things, there are two aspects,</t>
    <t s="17">one aspect belonging to the upper,</t>
    <t s="18">and a second aspect belonging to the lower,</t>
    <t s="19">and through the two aspects within it, it becomes a connecting medium.</t>
    <t s="20">Similarly, it will be understood regarding the Torah, which is the medium connecting the Neshama of Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="21">that there is in the Torah an aspect belonging to the creations,</t>
    <t s="22">and an aspect belonging to the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="23">and through this it connects the Neshama of Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="24">For,</t>
    <t s="25">the Torah is clothed in physical matters, etc.,</t>
    <t s="26">and from this aspect it belongs to the creations,</t>
    <t s="27">and in general this is the matter of the revealed aspect of Torah.</t>
    <t s="28">And there is an aspect in the Torah as it is in spiritual matters,</t>
    <t s="29">and this is the aspect of the hidden aspect of Torah that speaks about G-dly matters,</t>
    <t s="30">therefore it is hidden</t>
    <t s="31">(relative to us),</t>
    <t s="32">for the Torah is the wisdom and will of the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="33">And through these two aspects, the Torah is a medium connecting Ein Sof, blessed be He, and the Neshama of Yisrael.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>In greater depth, the Torah emanates from Chochmah Sstimah, the true medium, where its two aspects are not separate but one, just as in the soul's intellect the power of abstraction and descent are one, and similarly the Torah's revealed and hidden aspects are unified, making it the true covenant.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the explanation of these two aspects in the Torah in greater depth,</t>
    <t s="1">it is known that what "the Torah emanates from Chochmah"</t>
    <t s="2">does not mean only lower Chochmah and upper Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="3">but rather Chochmah Sstimah,</t>
    <t s="4">for Chochmah Sstimah is the true medium.</t>
    <t s="5">For,</t>
    <t s="6">the entirety of Kesser is a medium between Ein Sof, the Emanator, and the emanated beings,</t>
    <t s="7">and this is through the two aspects in Kesser,</t>
    <t s="8">the lower aspect of the Emanator,</t>
    <t s="9">and the first aspect of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="10">for through these two aspects</t>
    <t s="11">(the lower aspect of the Emanator and the source and origin of the emanated beings)</t>
    <t s="12">Kesser becomes a medium to connect Ein Sof, the Emanator, with Atzilus.</t>
    <t s="13">However, these two aspects as they are in Kesser,</t>
    <t s="14">they are two distinct levels,</t>
    <t s="15">and this is not the true concept of the medium,</t>
    <t s="16">and the true medium is the aspect of Chochmah Sstimah,</t>
    <t s="17">for in Chochmah Sstimah these two aspects</t>
    <t s="18">(the belonging to the Emanator and the belonging to Atzilus)</t>
    <t s="19">are not two distinct levels,</t>
    <t s="20">but rather they are as one,</t>
    <t s="21">therefore it is the true medium.</t>
    <t s="22">And this will be understood through an analogy, as we see below in the soul of man,</t>
    <t s="23">that in the power of Chochmah there are two opposite matters,</t>
    <t s="24">the power of abstraction and wondrous separation,</t>
    <t s="25">and the power of descent and clothing.</t>
    <t s="26">The matter of wondrous separation in Chochmah is that it has the power to abstract the intellect from material forms and also from physical forms and even from spiritual forms,</t>
    <t s="27">meaning it abstracts the intellect from all forms within it,</t>
    <t s="28">length, width, and depth,</t>
    <t s="29">and only the point remains,</t>
    <t s="30">which is the aspect of the point in Chochmah.</t>
    <t s="31">And the matter of descent and clothing of Chochmah is that the power of Chochmah can bring down the concept to the very lowest level,</t>
    <t s="32">like "he spoke three thousand proverbs,"</t>
    <t s="33">and even lower.</t>
    <t s="34">And,</t>
    <t s="35">these two matters in Chochmah are not two separate matters from each other,</t>
    <t s="36">but rather they are one matter.</t>
    <t s="37">For the power of descent is from the aspect of the power of wondrous separation,</t>
    <t s="38">for that which it has the power to bring down the concept to the very lowest level is because it grasfs the essential point of the intellect abstracted from all form,</t>
    <t s="39">and specifically because of this it is able to bring down the intellect to the very lowest level.</t>
    <t s="40">And similarly it will be understood above in the aspect of Chochmah Sstimah,</t>
    <t s="41">that the two aspects in Chochmah Sstimah,</t>
    <t s="42">the aspect belonging to the Emanator and the aspect belonging to Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="43">are not two separate matters from each other,</t>
    <t s="44">but rather they are one matter,</t>
    <t s="45">and therefore Chochmah Sstimah is the true medium.</t>
    <t s="46">And similarly it will be understood in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="47">that the two matters in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="48">that it is the wisdom of the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="49">and that it is clothed in physical matters,</t>
    <t s="50">are not two separate aspects from each other,</t>
    <t s="51">the revealed aspect of Torah and the hidden aspect of Torah,</t>
    <t s="52">but rather that "the Torah emanates from Chochmah"</t>
    <t s="53">(Sstimah)</t>
    <t s="54">"emerges,"</t>
    <t s="55">and from the aspect of the upper aspect of the Torah, specifically because of this it descended below and was clothed in physical matters.</t>
    <t s="56">And therefore the Torah is called a covenant,</t>
    <t s="57">which is the true medium between the Neshama of Yisrael and Ein Sof, blessed be He.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
